title: Create the access policy and token

blocks.content: The third value the SDK needs, so it can send your agent's data to your Grafana Cloud stack, is a Grafana Cloud Access Policy Token. You set it later as `AGENTO11Y_AUTH_TOKEN`. You create it on the same **Your credentials** panel of the setup screen where you copied the **API URL** and **Instance ID**, so you don't leave the setup screen or build an access policy by hand. The token carries four scopes: `sigil:write` for generations, plus `metrics:write`, `traces:write`, and `logs:write`, so the same token also serves traces and metrics in Milestone 7.
Create the token on the setup screen and save it.
Go back to the **Your credentials** panel on the Agent Observability setup screen, the same panel where you copied the **API URL** and **Instance ID**.

On the **API token** row of **Your credentials**, click **Create token**. The app creates a Grafana Cloud Access Policy Token already scoped with `sigil:write`, `metrics:write`, `traces:write`, and `logs:write`, so you don't pick the scopes yourself.

- Optional: click **Customize token** to set a token name or an expiry date. The token is otherwise non-expiring, unless your organization requires one.
- Copy the token now with the copy button and save it somewhere you can find it later, such as a notes file. You enter it as `AGENTO11Y_AUTH_TOKEN` in the next milestone. Tokens start with `glc_`.
- The token is shown only once, until you reload the page. Store it securely, for example in a secret manager. If you lose it, create another token.
blocks.hint: Don't see **Create token**? On stacks where in-app creation isn't available, the **API token** row shows **Create a token in Cloud Access Policies** instead. Click it, create an access policy with the `sigil:write`, `metrics:write`, `traces:write`, and `logs:write` scopes, add a token, and copy it once it appears.

blocks.content: Your token is created with the four scopes and saved for later.
